author: mrtan
description:
NLQTSBench-train-v2
	

Second training set for NLQTSBench.
It sits next to mrtan/NLQTSBench-train, which is unchanged.
It holds 690 tasks over all 11 sub-tasks, including Composite Trend.
The skill library of the Sonar-TS moso branch was distilled from it.
The tasks use the same question templates as the test set, generated with different and more widely varying parameters.
No task id and no question text of this set appears in the test set.
Do not use it for benchmarking.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mrtan/NLQTSBench-train-v2.
